text: Boom, a young woman working at a Thai country club, falls pregnant by the married Prathan, who pays for her silence and then, with a video camera running, [shares her with his friends on a beach|wrong|sexual violation]. Slapped and dismissed in front of his family, [she goes to a black magic shaman|threat|witchcraft and cursed things] for revenge on them all. One by one Prathan's household dies, and when his first wife inherits the house, Boom [turns her curses on the new family for the money|wants|wealth and ambition], while [her lost daughter's ghost|images|babies, birth and pregnancy] walks the rooms.
